thread:
SRE-Oncall-Bot: SLO alert: hosted-infer.usw2 p99 latency > 500ms for 5m (current burn 3.1%). 5xx fraction up ~1.8%. Paging eng-sre.
Alex: saw the alert, jumping in. Any obvious rollout in the last 30m? :eyes:
Sam: not seeing a code rollout in Deploys, last was 2h ago. Quick dashboard: https://console.redwood/infer/slo/usw2 -> p99 spike starts ~3141592400
Meera: logs show a cluster of upstream handshake timeouts and `prefetch` errors around the same time. Traces sparse for those requests, lots of missing spans.
Jaya: can you paste the log query you used? trying to reproduce locally.
Meera: sure, running in Logs:
```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND log_ts >= 3141592300
json.payload.level="error" AND json.payload.msg: ("handshake timeout" OR "prefetch failed" OR "kv cache miss")
| parse json.payload.request_id as req
| stats count() by json.payload.err, bin(1m)
```
Sam: running that now, I'm seeing a tail focused on batcher-v2 pod set: `batcher-v2-.*` -> high queue depth and repeated 504 from infer-proxy
Alex: correlating with infra metrics: GPU utilization normal, but proxy connection attempts spike and reset counters go up. Could be connection pool exhaustion or backend cold-starts.
Vince: support ticket INC-2026-874 opened by Support with customer complain about timeouts in API. They've sent sample request_ids: req_0a9c, req_f3e2.
Meera: checked one trace (req_0a9c) — trace exists but missing backend spans after proxy handoff. Likely trace sampling or dropped spans on TLS handshake failure.
Jaya: hypothesis: prefetch agent that warms KV/cache for long-context sessions is failing under a short-term traffic pattern, causing many cold requests to hit slower path and timeout.
Sam: I prepared a quick repro load: small script to fire many multi-turn requests with long prompts that exercise prefix caching. `loadtest.sh`:
```
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate &
done; wait
```
```
Watching batcher backlog with `kubectl top` shows backlog grow and then many 504s.
Alex: temporary mitigation: increase proxy connection timeout and bump prefetch worker count for the affected pool. Meera/Jaya can we do a quick canary change?
Meera: I can patch prefetch replicas +1 on `prefetch-usw2-prod` and bump proxy keepalive to 90s. Will do a 1-min canary.
Vince: Support is ready to message customer with a status update if we have mitigation steps.
Sam: also adding a log-based alert for trace gaps: metric `trace_missing_after_proxy_handshake` > 0.5% over 5m.
Jaya: rolling the canary now: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment prefetch-usw2-prod --replicas=4` and `kubectl patch configmap proxy-config -p '{"data":{"keepalive":"90s"}}'`
Meera: canary looks good so far, p99 dropping from ~720ms -> ~340ms in the canary subset. 5xx fraction down in those pods.
Alex: good. Action items: (1) keep canary for 15m, (2) collect flamegraphs and connection stats, (3) follow up with infra team to review connection pool sizing and prefetch failure modes, (4) support update to customer.
Vince: support will send interim note: "we're mitigating high-latency and timeout issues in US-WEST2, applying temporary scaling and connection fixes; investigating root cause". Ticket INC-2026-874 updated.
Sam: creating a short dashboard tile for `trace gaps` and `prefetch error rate` so we can monitor post-mitigation.
Alex: if canary stays stable, we should roll to full pool in 30m and open a postmortem if RCA shows a systemic config issue. Assign postmortem to Meera + Jaya.
Meera: noted. I'll capture the repro script and attach logs + trace ids.
Jaya: 👍 will also create a short runbook entry: when p99 spike + missing spans -> check prefetch metrics, batcher backlog, proxy resets.
SRE-Oncall-Bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-31415926, severity=sev2, owners=[Meera,Jaya], status=mitigated-canary
Alex: thanks team. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
